export function useAuthMode() {
  return useQuery<AuthModeResponse, ApiError>({
    queryKey: authModeKeys.all,
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => request<AuthModeResponse>('/system/auth-mode', { signal }),
    staleTime: AUTH_MODE_STALE_MS,

  })
